When you gain control, talk to the one of the first guys you see, Penniless
Mike, the one in the purple suit. He'll ask you if you want a rare card.

————————————————————————————————
   [1] I want it, I admit it!
   [2] I'm no card freak.
————————————————————————————————

If you have _7,000 CASH_ on you (yeah, it's pricey), then choose 1 to obtain
the [_SUN CARD_]. Just to the right of Penniless Mike is a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]
on the ground, so be sure to pick it up. Next, talk to the bum at the top of
the screen, Drunken Orro. He's your next Lottery Member!

While the speed of the indicator isn't anything unusual, all of the areas are
TINY! Equip the Pocket Watch before playing, and they'll be easier to hit. Make
sure to win the Priest Earrings here before continuing on; they decrease MP
consumption by 20%! If you don't win them, reload your last save and try again.
Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

Head north to the next area for a scene. Afterward, you'll realize that all
your money is gone, so now you've gotta get it back. First, go to your upper
left to be beside a house; now that you're past the gate, go up alongside the
house, behind the wall here. Look around on the ground, and you should find an
[_OAK SLINGSHOT_]. Go into the bar on the lower-left of the screen, where
you'll learn more about the London Rats, as well as get to name your final
party member, Halley.

  NOTE     There's a nice little easter egg for Koudelka up on the back wall of
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the bar; it's a portrait of Koudelka along with the word art from
           the game. Neat-o!

When you regain control, talk to the Silent Peddler on the left if you wish,
then make your way behind the counter of the bar, as there is a
[_MANA EXTRACT_] on the floor. Once you have it, leave the bar, then go back to
the first area of Old Castle Street. Go into the Inn at the bottom of the
screen for some events.

Leave the Inn and head north back to the next area. Make your way to the right
side of the area, then head north when you see an abandoned house. In this
small area, follow along the very edge of the street as you go left, and you
should find a [_THERA EXTRACT_] near the broken wall. Afterward, go to the
upper-left and examine the door on the ground; you'll have to do a Push Ring to
lift it up and descend the ladder into the London Rats' hideout.

On this platform, take a few steps to the left and examine the floor here to
find a set of [_DEMON EARRINGS_], then go down the small ramp, walking to the
far right side of the room to find a [_LOTTERY TICKET_] lying on the floor. Go
up the little set of wooden stairs to your left to make your way to a Save
Point, then continue along and up the ladder in the upper-right corner.

Check below the crate beside where you entered to find a [_SOUL BENEDICTION_],
then continue up the stairs. You'll see more scenes up here, where you'll get
your money back (minus a little bit that they already spent), as well as
receive a [_CRUCIFIX_]. You'll also be introduced to Halley, who will now
accompany you. Check the left side of the room to find a [_WARNING DEVICE_],
then check the area to the left of the fireplace on the right side of the room
for a [_TALISMANOFPURITY_].

Leave the hideout and make your way to the last house on the right side of
town, which is the residence of Knowledgeable Carl. After a rather short
discussion in here, check the floor by the bench on your left for a [_SEAL OF
FORCE_], the bookshelf to the upper-left for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_], and the
smaller bookshelf to the upper-left for a [_KIRIN SCALE_].

That's it for Old Castle Street for just a moment. Head out to the World Map,
then go to the Orphanage that appears.


   Orphanage
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
After the quick scene, enter the mansion to meet a man named Jack. After
another short discussion, you'll be escorted out. Leave the Orphanage, and
after another quick scene, you'll be back at the Inn on Old Castle Street.


   Old Castle Street
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Watch the events here, then go back out to the streets. Make your way back to
the London Rats' hideout, where you'll need to pick out a new party that
includes both Yuri and Halley, who has now officially joined your party. I
recommend Alice as a dedicated healer.

  NOTE     Halley comes equipped with a [_SLINGSHOT_] and a
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   [_REDLEATHERJACKET_] by default. Make sure to equip him with the
           Oak Slingshot you found earlier.

If you need to upgrade your equipment, stop in at the bar and talk to the
Silent Peddler to do so. When you're ready, leave Old Castle Street and make
your way to the Orphanage once again.

  NOTE     If for some reason you really want one of the other three in your
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   party in place of Alice, you can go back to the Inn and talk to
           Meiyuan to do so.
